seoTitle: Gérard & Fils - Furniture lift hire for your move
seoDesc: Use our furniture lift to make your move easier and keep your heaviest belongings safe. Free quote and state-of-the-art equipment.
h1: Hire a furniture lift for your move in Brussels

body.p: Moving from a high floor or with bulky furniture can quickly become a real headache. Staircases that are too narrow, no lift, windows that are hard to reach… some layouts make conventional transport simply impossible.

Fortunately, the Gérard & Fils team knows how to deal with this kind of situation, thanks to its experience as removers and perfectly suited equipment. We offer tailor-made solutions to overcome access constraints safely.
Using a furniture lift is particularly recommended when:

ul: your furniture cannot be dismantled or is too large to be carried without difficulty
you have belongings that are hard to move safely, such as a piano, a sofa or large appliances
your corridors and staircases are too narrow
the building's co-ownership rules do not allow the common areas to be used for a move, for fear of damaging the walls

body.p: Trailer-mounted, truck-mounted, towable, GEDA demountable: our lifts suit every height and every access. Hiring a furniture lift simplifies your move and avoids the risk of accidents or damage to property. Our team does everything to keep the work running smoothly, at attractive rates and within the announced timeframes.

ul: Towable lift up to the 12th floor: weighing under 3.5 t, 2.10 m high and 1.85 m wide, it is an essential ally for moves in confined spaces.
Towable lift up to the 5th floor, weighing under 750 kg, 1.5 m high and 1.35 m wide, for even tighter spots.
Electric towable GEDA lift up to the 3rd floor, which can be set up anywhere close to a power socket.

sections.h: Quality you can always count on

body.p: At Gérard & Fils, the reliability of our equipment is a priority. All our lifts and furniture hoists are rigorously maintained and frequently inspected to guarantee optimal operation and complete safety on every job. We use only professional, powerful equipment suited to bulky or fragile loads, such as pianos or imposing pieces of furniture.

Our experienced operators handle each installation with precision, in compliance with safety standards and with recognised efficiency. Whether you need to move all your furniture or just a few heavy pieces, we take charge of the whole organisation: planning, logistics, and even booking the parking spaces needed for the lift or the truck.
Our clear, personalised quotes help you anticipate every stage of your move, with no hidden costs or nasty surprises. We are committed to meeting the announced deadlines and arriving on time.

Do you need a lift for your move? Send us all the necessary information (volume to be transported, floor height, layout of the premises…) by filling in our form and entrust your move to us from A to Z. Safety and reliability are the watchwords of Gérard & Fils.
